parsed.rationale: This ECG is not normal: there is clear convex ST elevation in II, III and aVF (largest in III, well above 1 mm in contiguous leads), with reciprocal ST depression in I and aVL and ST depression in V2–V3, which fits an acute inferior STEMI, possibly with posterior involvement.
